comment: Static assets the share viewer fetches at runtime, copied into docs/view/ by scripts/copy-viewer-assets.mjs. Kept in step with the built bundle by the guard test in scripts/__tests__/copyViewerAssets.test.ts, which greps docs/view/viewer.js for literal asset paths and fails on any this list does not cover - the list drifted once already and svg/axibridge-glyph.svg 404'd on every share view. JSON rather than a JS export so the list has one home that both the build script and its guard test can read without importing across the .mjs/.ts boundary (that import breaks on Windows). logo.json is deliberately absent: it is a per-user guild-logo manifest generated at publish time, not a public/ asset.
